name: Infested Armor
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Infested Armor

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to Armor Class .

effects.name: Fortification
effects.tooltip: Fortification +56% : +56% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Disease Guard
effects.tooltip: Disease Guard : This item carries the Maggot Plague disease, which deals 1d6 Constitution damage and may be contracted by enemies that hit you. A successful Fortitude save (DC 20) will negate this effect.

effects.name: Sheltering
effects.tooltip: Sheltering +8 : +8 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings

effects.name: DR/Good
effects.tooltip: Damage Reduction 5/Good : Reduces physical damage by 5, except from Good attacks.

flavor_text: An orthon warrior's body is crawling with hungry maggots that feed on its wounds. This suit of armor, crafted from the salvaged parts of an orthon's protective gear, is similarly infested and may impart a disease to those that attack the wearer.

source.raw: The Chronoscope , and The Chronoscope (Legendary) , Blood Plate 's Chest
